profile_text.body:
Scite is a for-profit startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in Brooklyn, NY, that describes itself as an AI-powered platform for discovering and evaluating scientific literature. The company says its platform searches more than 300 million scholarly articles and has indexed over 1.6 billion citations, drawing on a licensed database built through agreements with more than 40 publishers plus the full open access corpus. Scite describes itself as now part of Research Solutions and reports serving 2 million users worldwide.

The company's core product, also called Scite, centers on a feature it calls Smart Citations, which shows how a given paper, claim, method, or author has been supported, challenged, or discussed by later research. A second component, the Scite AI Assistant, uses those same citation signals to generate answers grounded in the broader literature, with each claim linked back to the specific sentence in the specific source paper. The site positions this sourcing approach as a distinguishing feature relative to tools that cannot access full paper text.

The held facts note that Scite operates a Model Context Protocol server, listed as ai.scite/mcp, which is described as enabling users to search full text, evaluate trust, and access full-text articles in order to ground answers in scientific literature. Scite's tracked law exposure is associated with New York, with 260 entries recorded, though no specific litigation cases are listed in the available data.
